name: What is custom trim installation and how does it differ from standard trim?

mainEntity.name: What is custom trim installation and how does it differ from standard trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom trim installation involves designing, cutting, and fitting decorative or functional woodwork tailored to your home's layout. This includes baseboards, crown molding, door and window casings, wainscoting, and chair rails. While standard trim uses basic off-the-shelf boards nailed in place, custom trim involves precise coping, mitering, and profile matching to resolve uneven walls or ceilings, ensuring seamless corners and flush joints. HH Remodeling handles this finish carpentry in-house, integrating carpentry with drywall touch-ups and finish painting to deliver a complete architectural accent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom trim involves measuring, cutting, and fitting detailed woodwork like crown molding or casing tailored to your walls, ensuring seamless joints even on uneven surfaces.
